Opposition Leaders Accuse Modi-Shah of Undermining Democracy

Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi have accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah of seeking to end democracy. Kharge specifically mentioned the Election Commission in his remarks. Rahul Gandhi stated that democracy has been ruined. One report noted that PM Modi was depicted as 'Mogambo' in a poster.
